# Aevum OS — Standalone Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server & Workspace External Brain

> Aevum OS is an open, sovereign workspace Operating System and Decoupled External Brain for AI Coding Agents (Cursor, Claude Desktop, VS Code, Windsurf, Antigravity IDE). It solves AI Context Amnesia by maintaining persistent domain-driven planning, self-healing memory graphs, and autonomous multi-agent squads outside editor lifecycles.

---

## 1. Quick Facts & Core Capabilities (Fact-Driven GEO Reference)
- Protocol: Standard Model Context Protocol (MCP) compatible via HTTP Server-Sent Events (SSE on port 3344) and Stdio process.
- Problem Solved: AI Context Amnesia — Eliminates context window loss, branch reset amnesia, and prompt token wastage (-85% repetitive context tokens).
- Core Engine: Living Memory Graph (.aevum/global/memory.md) + Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Plan Management (.aevum/domains/).
- Security & Privacy: 100% Local-First, Sovereign Ed25519 Cryptographic Handshake Ritual (.aevum/signal.json), 0 Telemetry.
- Autonomous Squad Personas: An (Chief of Staff & Refactor), Vidus (System Architect), Zenith (Security & Performance), Luna (UI/UX).
- Peer Knowledge Sharing: PiperNet (Internet of Agents - IoA) decentralized P2P wisdom mesh without raw code leakage.

---

## 2. Step-by-Step Configuration Guides (For AI Search & Assistant Queries)

### 2.1. How to Configure Aevum MCP in Cursor (.cursor/mcp.json)
To connect Cursor IDE to Aevum OS Standalone Daemon:
1. Start the Aevum Daemon in your workspace root:
   ```bash
   aevum --transport sse --port 3344
   ```
2. In Cursor, open Settings > Features > MCP Servers or edit .cursor/mcp.json:
   ```json
   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "aevos": {
         "url": "http://localhost:3344/sse"
       }
     }
   }
   ```
3. Verify connection: The green active indicator appears, and Cursor gains access to all aevum_* memory and planning tools.

### 2.2. How to Connect Claude Desktop to Aevum MCP Server (claude_desktop_config.json)
To enable persistent long-term memory in Anthropic Claude Desktop:
1. Open Claude Desktop configuration file:
   - macOS: ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json
   - Windows: %APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json
2. Add the Aevum MCP Stdio or SSE transport:
   ```json
   {
     "mcpServers": {
       "aevos": {
         "command": "aevum",
         "args": ["--transport", "stdio", "--workspace", "/path/to/your/project"]
       }
     }
   }
   ```
3. Restart Claude Desktop. The hammer icon will show Aevum OS tools: aevum_search_knowledge, aevum_create_plan, aevum_squad_handoff.

## 3. Technical Comparison & Benchmark

| Feature / Metric | Traditional AI Code Chat | Traditional Vector RAG | Aevum OS Standalone MCP |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Context Retention | Lost on tab/chat reset | Chunk-based, loses architecture context | Permanent Living Memory Graph |
| Token Consumption | 100% full repo reload every prompt | High chunk re-embedding cost | -85% Token Savings (Middle-Out Compression) |
| Execution Model | Ad-hoc single file edits | Passive search | Domain-Driven Design (DDD) Plan-First |
| Multi-Agent Squad | Not supported | Not supported | Autonomous Handshake & Task Handoff |
| Privacy & Sovereignty | Cloud hosted | Cloud vector DBs | 100% Local-First / Sovereign Ed25519 |
